title: AC1032 renderer lineage and peer recovery evidence boundary
mode: Primary-source project/issue review with local plan and selected source-owner cross-check
scope: Screen a newly visible AC1032 DWG consumer and determine whether it adds an independent parser, writer, or 3D semantic route.
Refresh LibreDWG #1357/#1359 and #1410 state and separate master observations, unmerged proposals, strict completeness, and recovery behavior.
Reconcile candidate routes with FreeCAD/GDAL scope and the existing implementation-ready parity owners.

method.limitations: GitHub default branches and project-authored README/issue reports are mutable. The dwg2png 11-file report has no visible input-hash/license manifest in the reviewed README. LibreDWG aggregate counts and issue comments are contributor-reported, not independently rerun. The search was targeted and does not prove that no other open-source project exists.

sources.observed: The repository pins acadrust 0.4.0 and describes a downstream 2D model/paper-space rendering and metadata route. It reports 11 real AC1032 DWGs and 23 pages but does not publish a hash-bound input manifest in the reviewed README. Its documented v1 omissions include HATCH fills, dimensions, leaders/MLEADER, MLINE, raster images, and 3D solids; spline rendering is an approximation.

Issue #1357's reporter says three AC1021 aggregate counts matched ODA File Converter at master commit 56a05f98 after contemporaneous R2007 decoder changes, without a bisect; #1359 remains a distinct open skip-and-warn proposal. #1410's issue-body DXF-import patch explicitly calls embedded-MTEXT handling a stopgap and points to group-101 scoped parsing as the intended direction. These are peer observations, not local reproductions or normative contracts.

FreeCAD documents a DWG-converter-to-DXF-to-selected-importer route and stock DXF importer limitations for ACIS solids. GDAL documents Binary DXF input from 3.12 and an optional AC1027+ raw ASM/transform projection, not B-rep construction. Neither route supplies the independent ACIS/AcDs semantic result required by the plan.

plan_impact.existing_owner_refinement: Add dwg2png as an optional, same-ACadRust-lineage 2D viewport/render projection only; retain strict source-identity accounting and embedded-MTEXT group-101 scope under existing PAR-49/7G.3, PAR-28, and PAR-19 owners.

repository_state: Plan and research receipt updated in the existing broadly dirty shared worktree. No files were staged or committed.
